nom: Beekman 1802 Milk Scrub Oat and Goat Milk Exfoliating Facial Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe sensitive skin, including several with eczema or acne-prone sensitive skin, consistently report no irritation, stinging, or redness, and some say it even calmed active breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with severe facial dryness and another with recurring dry patches on the chin, report the scrub leaves skin hydrated and soft rather than tight or stripped.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention mature or aging skin, including women in their sixties and seventies, say the scrub is gentle enough for their reduced tolerance for exfoliants, though one found it too gentle to remove makeup.
segments.combination: The reviewers who mention combination skin report the scrub cleared excess oil and buildup without irritating their skin.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers connect the scrub to aging skin: one says it visibly smoothed rough texture she attributes to aging, and another who had grown less tolerant of exfoliants with age found it nourishing rather than irritating.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including some with dry or dehydrated skin, say the scrub leaves skin hydrated and soft rather than stripped, and it is credited with clearing dry patches on one reviewer's chin after regular use.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers credit the oat and turmeric with calming redness, with one noting no redness or tugging felt after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who worried a scrub could cause microtears found this one gentle enough not to compromise her skin, and several others likewise describe it as non-abrasive even with daily or twice-weekly use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin say the scrub calmed active breakouts or helped avoid new ones, including one who saw her acne improve after about two weeks and another who avoided post-menopause breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who describes combination oily-dry skin says the scrub removed excess oil and makeup residue without over-drying her skin.

aspects.libelle: Granules can be slow to rinse off
Some feel it leaves a greasy film
Can sting if it gets in eyes

extraits.texte: I normally use Truly Face Scrub but the store was out. One of the associates recommended this and said it was just as good. I however disagree. My face doesn't feel clean at all, it leaves a greasy film and it's really thick. I will not be purchasing again.

I wanted to love this, as I do most of Beekman's products but this didn't leave my face feeling clean. Pros: not too scented, doesn't irritate my sensitive skin Cons: doesn't make my skin feel clean, leaves oily film Unfortunately, I would not order this again or recommend this particular product

Very very gentle face cleaner. So gentle it didn't remove my make up hence minus 1 star....it is super gentle which is great for mature skin and/or persons with some dermo issues. I am going to keep it & just use my reg face wash first....it does leave your skin smooth & soft.
I have extremely sensitive skin (acne + eczema) and this scub works perfectly! Its helped my acne as well. Highly recommend!

I recently tried a different product from another company that ruined my very sensitive combination skin. After searching for a few weeks trying to find a new product that would be more pleasant on my skin, the skincare specialist at Ulta showed this cleanser scrub to me. I was skeptical at first but gave it a try. I have been using it for 4 days now. It doesn't irritate my skin at all, feels very soothing, feels gentle on my acne spots, makes my skin feel very smooth, does not dry me out, and is helping to clear my blemishes. It is great for daily use, I use it both in the morning and the evening with no issues.

I use this product every morning and night. I recently have gotten dry patches on my chin area. This as helped me with my dry patches. I put a dime size amount on and use circular motion to apply. After I washed off the product, my skin was soft, glowy, dry patches disappeared and I did not get any breakouts with this product. I've used other brands that didn't work, this is a must for your everyday skincare routine. I 100 percent recommend this product.
